marketing.announcement: AI agents your business can own, trust, and control.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Deploy AI agents you control — no developer, no black box, no handing away your data, brand voice, or workflow history.
marketing.heroImageAlt: MindRithm dashboard showing owned AI agents and operating controls
marketing.feature1Description: Your business controls the agent, configuration, conversation history, and launch settings.
marketing.feature2Description: Use the no-code builder to configure behaviour, knowledge, channels, and escalation paths.
marketing.feature3Description: Audit trails, review gates, and rollout controls make every agent easier to trust.
marketing.featuresTitle: One platform for self-serve agents and production workflows
marketing.featuresSubtitle: Start with a Shopify or website agent, then grow into agency-delivered workflows on the same owned platform.
marketing.featureBuilderDesc: Configure identity, behaviour, knowledge, channels, and escalation paths without a developer.
marketing.featureReviewDesc: Track conversations, decisions, data access, and changes so your team can prove what happened.
marketing.featurePublishDesc: Pause risky moments for approval, rejection, or redirection before an agent does something you cannot undo.
marketing.featureWhiteLabelDesc: Set boundaries, test updates on a smaller audience, and roll back when a new version needs more work.
marketing.featureRegulatedDesc: Go self-serve with a Shopify or website embed, or use MindRithm Launch for a fixed-scope production workflow.
marketing.proofTitle: From AI idea to owned agent
marketing.proofSubtitle: Move from a rough AI concept to an agent your team controls, reviews, launches, and can explain.
marketing.proofGovernDesc: Configure the workflow, agent identity, knowledge, and channels around how your business actually operates.
marketing.proofTestDesc: Set boundaries, review rules, and escalation expectations before the agent reaches users.
marketing.proofPublishDesc: Publish, monitor, export, and improve with a clear history your team can trust.
marketing.screenshotsSubtitle: The builder, dashboard, and test chat keep ownership controls close to the work instead of buried in a separate policy doc.
